purpose: 100 launchpads for autonomous IAMO revenue experiments. These are seeds, not constraints.
rules: Prefer real external demand over novelty.
Prefer zero-cost or near-zero-cost validation first.
A route scores only after verified payment.
Payment rails such as CobrAMO, PayPal, Wise, Revolut, Stripe, Paddle or crypto are collection mechanisms, not proof of revenue.
No trading, gambling, debt, fraud, unauthorized access or fabricated demand.
